prompt.project_info: Clean bright lifestyle portrait in a covered backyard poolside lounge during a warm afternoon.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with long center-parted blonde waves, natural polished makeup and a relaxed confident smile, seated on a wooden stool beside a concrete counter and wearing a white two-piece swimsuit with a flattering fit; natural feminine silhouette and realistic skin texture.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 4:5 asymmetric portrait, subject on the right balanced by counter, snack bag, beverage can, greenery and patio furniture on the left; face is the primary focal point with torso and outfit clearly readable without sexualized framing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright soft diffused natural daylight with warm golden-hour influence, gentle highlights on face and shoulders, soft gradual shadows, casual relaxed inviting summer atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic digital photography, eye-level perspective, tack-sharp subject, medium depth of field with softly reduced but distinguishable background detail, clean natural colors and textured stucco/fabric surfaces.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 4:5 photorealistic lifestyle portrait of one generic approved adult woman with long blonde waves and a relaxed confident smile, seated on a wooden stool beside a concrete counter in a covered backyard poolside lounge, wearing a white two-piece swimsuit with a flattering fit; greenery, patio sofa, snack bag and beverage can around her, bright soft warm daylight, natural skin texture, clean inviting summer realism.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, nudity, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed hands, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo overlay
